user.title: Connect to your Dahua VTO
user.description: Enter the connection details of your Dahua VTO door station. The integration connects directly over the local network (TCP port 5000 by default) using the DHIP protocol – the same one used by the DMSS app.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device

init.title: Dahua VTO options
init.description: Comma separated list of door relay channels to expose as buttons (e.g. 1,2).
